_comment_id: Sequential ID like PASS-0006. Use the next available number.
_comment_title: Descriptive title of the philatelic event or exhibition
_comment_event: Official name of the event/exhibition, e.g., 'INDIPEX 2023'
_comment_venue: Venue name where the event was held
_comment_city: City where the event was held
_comment_state: State where the event was held
_comment_date: Date of the event/seal impression, in YYYY-MM-DD format
_comment_sealType: Type of seal, e.g., 'Commemorative Seal', 'Special Event Seal', 'Exhibition Entry Seal', 'Special Cancellation'
_comment_passportPage: Page number in your Philately Passport where this seal appears, e.g., '1', '2A'
_comment_image: Path to the seal image relative to public/. e.g., '/images/passport/PASS-XXXX/seal.webp'. Leave empty if no image.
_comment_description: Description of the seal, event, and its significance
_comment_notes: Personal notes about this seal entry
